name: demo_one
description: make demo-one script. The model first names a station that is not in the KB (hook cancels it), looks up the right station, plans, drafts with the wrong option (steering guides it), drafts with BART's option, and submits a Plan whose minutes match the computed ones.

steps: Ask the station agent for a shuttle.
Take the Platform 1 elevator to the opposite platform.
Ride one stop to Bay Fair.
Cross to the San Francisco-bound platform and board your train.
Take the Platform 1 elevator to the opposite platform.
Ride one stop to Bay Fair.
Cross to the San Francisco-bound platform and board your train.
input.message: San Leandro: the SF-direction platform elevator is out. Take the Platform 1 elevator to the opposite platform, ride one stop to Bay Fair, and board your San Francisco train there. Adds about 14 minutes.
